summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16, Tuple[ControlType, str] added to ControlCode union); rich/control.py (format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and Control.title classmethod with docstring); rich/console.py (Console.set_window_title returning True when written on a terminal, False otherwise, with docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py (legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200). Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only module mark). Black formatting was checked by hand against 88 columns, not by running Black. Nothing was executed, so test results are unverified.
